# Gamma Inspiration — Unique Premium Design

Source: https://gamma.app/inspiration — infinite canvas of sales, marketing, and product slides. Learn what works and use them to build your next big presentation. Gamma: effortless AI design for presentations, documents, websites, graphics — 100+ themes, 100M+ users.

## When to Use
- Designing premium PDF for ST Product Package (30+ pages, PDF Craft) OR Freebie (10-15 pages, Freebie PDF Craft) — need unique, Gamma-inspired layout not template copy
- Designing HTML presentation that feels custom-crafted, not generic
- Need storytelling principles, visual hierarchy, and layout inspiration

## Gamma Design Principles (from Inspiration Gallery)

### Storytelling Principles Collection
- **Infinite canvas** — sales, marketing, product slides as learnable patterns
- **What works**: study Gamma's inspiration gallery for layout, visual hierarchy, and storytelling patterns that convert
- **Use to build**: apply learned patterns to your next presentation — not copy, but translate principles

### Gamma Product Capabilities (Design Inspiration)
- **Presentations**: turn any idea into polished deck, export PPT/PDF
- **Documents**: structured visual documents — one-pagers to white papers
- **Websites**: shareable hosted sites, no developers
- **Graphics**: custom on-brand infographics to illustrations via AI design agent

- **Sharing**: export PPT/PDF/PNG/Google Slides, publish as website/social, track engagement

### Design Patterns to Extract
When researching Gamma inspirations for a topic:
1. **Layout patterns**: how Gamma structures sales vs marketing vs product slides — hero, comparison, timeline, feature grid, testimonial, pricing, CTA
2. **Visual hierarchy**: typography scale, color blocking, whitespace, card systems
3. **Storytelling flow**: narrative arc (problem → solution → proof → action), not just feature lists
4. **Uniqueness**: every Gamma deck feels custom — avoid template repetition; vary layout, diagram style, code density, table frequency, callout style per topic
5. **Screen-first**: Gamma is screen-first design — 16:9, interactive, hyperlinked, not print-first

## Workflow for ST Product Package

### For Product PDF Craft Agent (30+ pages)
1. **Research Gamma inspirations** relevant to topic (search gamma.app/inspiration for topic-adjacent decks)
2. **Extract layout principles**: which Gamma patterns fit this topic's content (e.g., testing toolkit → code-heavy + architecture diagrams; resume kit → clean typography + sample layouts; marketing playbook → bold headers + case study callouts)
3. **Translate to ReportLab**: custom Flowables (CalloutBox, CodeBlock, SectionDivider, ArchitectureDiagram, FlowDiagram) with Gamma-inspired visual treatment — not raw primitives
4. **Ensure uniqueness**: layout, diagram style, content density must reflect topic — never produce two products that look identical except text; brand palette/fonts consistent, layout varies

### For Freebie PDF Craft Agent (10-15 pages)
1. **Research Gamma inspirations** relevant to freebie topic — same gallery, but adapt for lead-magnet / Gumroad freebie level (lighter, more visual, tighter storytelling)
2. **Extract layout principles** for freebie format: which Gamma patterns fit this freebie's Format Signal (flowchart-heavy → diagram-forward layout; question-bank → structured table layout; checklist → card/grid layout; report → editorial layout)
3. **Translate to ReportLab**: same custom Flowables but scaled for 10-15 pages — fewer sections, more visual density per page, still premium (not plain markdown-to-PDF)
4. **Ensure uniqueness**: every freebie feels custom — vary layout, diagram style, callout style per topic; brand palette/fonts/header/footer consistent as series, internal layout varies

### For HTML Slides Agent
1. **Research Gamma inspirations** for presentation structure and visual storytelling
2. **Combine with frontend-slides + cinematic-ui + design-system**: Gamma provides the storytelling/layout inspiration, frontend-slides provides structure, cinematic-ui provides art direction, design-system provides brand tokens
3. **Build cinematic 16:9 deck** that feels Gamma-level polished — distinctive, not generic AI-slop

### For Product Research Specialist
- Include Gamma inspiration research in visual-decision.md — which Gamma patterns inform PDF/HTML structure for this topic
- Document why chosen patterns fit topic's content and buyer needs

### For Freebie Research
- Include Gamma inspiration research in freebie-visual-decision.md — which Gamma patterns inform freebie PDF structure for this topic + Format Signal
- Document why chosen patterns fit freebie's content and buyer needs; note how freebie layout differs from product layout for same topic

## Key Rules
- **Inspiration, not copy** — learn principles from Gamma, don't replicate specific decks
- **Topic-adaptive** — Gamma patterns adapt to topic; testing toolkit looks different from resume kit; freebie question-bank looks different from freebie flowchart
- **Premium signal** — Gamma-level design visibly signals paid product (₹149-699) OR premium freebie (lead-magnet that previews paid quality) on open — not converted Word doc or plain markdown-to-PDF
- **Screen-first**: 16:9, Inter/Roboto/SF Pro, 4.5:1 contrast, no-bleed, interactive hyperlinks
- **Combine with other skills**: Gamma (storytelling/layout) + frontend-slides (HTML structure) + cinematic-ui (film art direction) + design-system (brand tokens) + animated-web-components (animation primitives) = complete HTML/PDF system
- **Freebie = premium preview**: freebie PDF should feel like a premium product in miniature — same Gamma-inspired quality, tighter scope (10-15 pages), still custom-crafted not template
